Forecast Apple Inc.'s (AAPL) reported financial results for the fiscal 2026 third quarter, using only information available as of the task cutoff.

Provide point forecasts for total net sales; net sales for each product and service category; total, products and services gross margin in dollars and as percentages; total operating expenses; other income/(expense), net; effective tax rate; net income; diluted weighted-average shares; and diluted earnings per share.

Also provide a category-level revenue bridge reconciling year-over-year changes to total net sales and the total year-over-year change, a bridge reconciling gross margin through operating expenses, other income and taxes to net income and diluted EPS, and low and high uncertainty bounds for total net sales and diluted EPS.
